project_identity.identity: Personal brand site for a self-taught Finance Technologist and educator. This is a LEARNING SPACE — not a sales page. The tone is warm, human, curious, mentor-like. Never corporate, never pushy.
project_identity.primary_goal: Make technology emotionally understandable for humans.
project_identity.what_this_is_not: Not an educational platform. Not a product store. Not a portfolio. It is the personal space of one person sharing what he has learned.

tech_stack.framework: Next.js 14 — App Router ONLY. No pages/ directory. No getStaticProps. No getServerSideProps.
tech_stack.styling: TailwindCSS — only use classes that map to design-tokens.json. No arbitrary values.
tech_stack.language: TypeScript — all files are .tsx or .ts. No .js or .jsx.
tech_stack.icons: Heroicons v2 ONLY — import from @heroicons/react/24/outline or /24/solid. No other icon library.
tech_stack.animation: CSS transitions only. IntersectionObserver for scroll-reveal. No Framer Motion.

design_system_summary.full_tokens_in: config/design-tokens.json — this summary is for quick reference only. Always read the full token file for implementation.

folder_structure.app/api/contact/route.ts: Contact form POST handler — uses Resend
folder_structure.app/layout.tsx: Root layout — Navbar + Footer + font setup
folder_structure.components/sections/: One .tsx per 'component' value in page JSONs
folder_structure.components/sections/index.ts: Barrel export — keys must match JSON component values exactly
folder_structure.components/ui/: Button, Card, Badge, SectionHeader, Divider, Navbar, Footer
folder_structure.config/: ALL content and design — never hardcode values that exist here
folder_structure.public/og/: Open Graph images per page (1200x630 png)

component_registry._note: Auto-extracted from all page JSONs. These are the only valid 'component' values. The index.ts barrel export must include all of these.

ui_primitives_registry._note: Shared building blocks in components/ui/. Used inside section components. All 7 must be implemented before starting Phase 4.

used_by: Most sections — eyebrow + title + subtitle block
Between sections as a horizontal separator

Footer.note: Rendered in app/layout.tsx. Social links + nav links + copyright.

naming_conventions.css_classes: Tailwind utility classes only — no custom CSS unless unavoidable

config_consumption_rules.rule_1: Never hardcode any color value. Use Tailwind classes mapped to design-tokens.json.
config_consumption_rules.rule_2: Never hardcode any text/copy inside a component. All copy comes from the page JSON passed as props.
config_consumption_rules.rule_3: Never hardcode spacing, border-radius, or shadow values. Use Tailwind token classes.
config_consumption_rules.rule_4: Every section component receives its full JSON section object as a 'data' prop.
config_consumption_rules.rule_5: Page metadata (title, description, og_image) comes from _page_meta in each page JSON.

rendering_rules.all_pages: SSG by default — no 'use client' on page files
rendering_rules.interactive_components: 'use client' only on components with useState/useEffect/event handlers

must_never_do: Use default Tailwind color names (blue-600, gray-400) — always use project tokens
Add external links without target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'
Use Framer Motion, GSAP, AOS, or any animation library
Use lucide-react, react-icons, font-awesome — Heroicons only
Use the pages/ directory — App Router only
Hardcode any text string inside a component — read from props/config
Break the build because a PLACEHOLDER_ value is present — handle gracefully

placeholder_values._note: These PLACEHOLDER_ values exist in config but are not real yet. Do NOT break the build because of them.
placeholder_values.social_urls: PLACEHOLDER_* in talk-to-me.json — render as href='#' with disabled style
placeholder_values.pricing: PLACEHOLDER_PRICE in learnings.json and my-builts.json — render as 'Coming Soon'
placeholder_values.thumbnails: Missing images — use a div with bg-primary-100 as placeholder
placeholder_values.hobbies: Empty array in about.json profile.hobbies.items — render nothing if empty

contact_form_api.behavior: Show inline success/error after submit. No page redirect. Client-side validation before POST.

what_was_already_decided.payment_in_v1: placeholder only — placeholder — Razorpay / Stripe integration in v2
